diagnostics.message: `:resource.local_file.public_ssh_key` explicitly depends on `:resource.tls_private_key.ssh`, but its `content` already references `tls_private_key.ssh.public_key_openssh`, which establishes the same dependency implicitly. The explicit `depends_on` is redundant.

`:resource.local_file.private_ssh_key` explicitly depends on `:resource.tls_private_key.ssh`, but its `content` already references `tls_private_key.ssh.private_key_pem`, which establishes the same dependency implicitly. The explicit `depends_on` is redundant.

`module.runner:resource.aws_launch_configuration.gitlab_runner_instance` should depend on `module.runner:resource.aws_ssm_parameter.runner_registration_token`: the launch configuration's user_data writes the runner registration token into that SSM parameter, so the Terraform-managed parameter must exist before the ASG launches the runner instance.

`module.runner:resource.aws_launch_configuration.gitlab_runner_instance` should depend on `module.runner:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ssm`: the runner instance's user_data needs the SSM policy on its instance role at boot to write the registration token.

`module.runner:resource.aws_launch_configuration.gitlab_runner_instance` should depend on `module.runner:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.instance_docker_machine_policy`: the runner agent needs its EC2/docker-machine permissions attached before the instance starts provisioning docker-machine runners.

`module.runner:resource.aws_launch_configuration.gitlab_runner_instance` should depend on `module.runner:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.docker_machine_cache_instance`: the runner agent's role must have the cache policy attached before instances launch and use the shared build cache.

`module.runner:resource.aws_launch_configuration.gitlab_runner_instance` should depend on `module.runner:resource.aws_iam_role_policy.instance`: the instance's CloudWatch logging setup starts at boot and requires the logging policy on its instance role to be attached first.

`module.runner:resource.aws_launch_configuration.gitlab_runner_instance` should depend on `module.runner:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.service_linked_role`: the runner agent may create AWS service-linked roles (e.g. for spot provisioning), so this policy must be attached before the runner instance begins operating.
